author: Harrison, J. and Davies, C.T.H.
title: $B \rightarrow D^*$ vector, axial-vector and tensor form factors for the full $q^2$ range from lattice QCD

data.note: Quadratic BGL fit, $P(z)\phi(z)\mathcal{F}(z)=\sum_n a_n z^n$, to synthetic $B\to D^*$ form factors at $w=1.025$, $1.225$ and $1.425$ generated from this paper's lattice results (Table \texttt{bglfitparams}), with the Blaschke factors, outer functions and $B_c^{(*)}$ resonances of Bigi:2017jbd as in FermilabLattice:2021cdg. $a_0^{F_1}$ is fixed by $F_1(1)=M_B(1-r)f(1)$ and is not stored; no correlation matrix is published. The $B_s\to D_s^*$ update, which supersedes Harrison:2021tol, and the tensor form factors are given only through the $(w-1)$ fit-function parameters of the ancillary file, so they are not stored as $z$-expansion coefficients.
